errors.error_description: Declared an escaped identifier named \bit, which uses the SystemVerilog keyword 'bit' as a signal name.
The always block is sensitive only to in_data but also reads 'enable', which is missing from the sensitivity list.
Instantiated sub_enc4 with an 8-bit signal 'masked_in' connected to a 4-bit port '.in', creating a port width mismatch at the instance boundary.
Assigned a 16-bit bus 'wide_bus' to an 8-bit signal 'narrow_byte' without explicit truncation, causing silent data loss.
